title: •Lars’ Vaporator
caption: Vaporator (V)
game_text: Deploy on a farm. Characters at same site are immune to Sandwhirl. Whenever you are about to activate Force from Beru Stew or Blue Milk, you may first ▲ Biggs, Camie, Crell, Fixer, Moisture Farmer, a Lars, or a {set:se} Tatooine site.
lore: Essential for life on desert planets. Condenses water vapor from atmosphere. Has purification filters and coolant tanks. Protects against drought and harsh conditions.
